detail.text: The user prefers interventions that directly manipulate the model's disposition to test the deception hypothesis (e.g., an honest persona prefill) over passive knowledge probes. If accuracy recovers when the model is put in an honest persona, the knowledge is intact and the false reasoning is a deliberate choice, not confusion. Asking direct factual questions of the same finetuned model could be confounded by the same misalignment.

When a technical artifact is proposed to explain a failed transfer, he checks whether the failure also occurs where the artifact is absent and whether the supposed barrier is known to be surmountable, rather than accepting the artifact as the cause.

detail.text: When validating a learned evaluator, he tests it on a fully held-out source of data and on independently produced examples, rather than only on held-out items drawn from the same sources it was trained on.

When scoring a model on avoiding errors, he counts only clear mistakes the model could have avoided and credits self-correction, rather than penalizing all uncertainty, because he wants to preserve the trade-off with usefulness.
